input.quote: During the term of this Agreement and for a period of one year thereafter, both parties agree not to hire or allow its respective affiliates to hire any employee of the other party, or any person who was an employee of the other party during the previous six months and who was directly involved in the provision of services under this Agreement.
input.rationale: Section 19 is a mutual no-hire, not a non-solicit: it bars each party (and its affiliates) from hiring "any employee of the other party" for the term plus one year, with no general-advertising or unsolicited-approach carve-out. No-hire provisions covering all personnel are walk-away territory under this rule, so the clause fails the fallback on material terms. We have narrowed it with minimal edits to the fallback bargain — mutual, limited to personnel directly involved in the services, 12 months from the end of that involvement, carve-outs for general advertisements and unsolicited approaches, and no hiring prohibition.

mappings.element: The restriction covers only personnel directly involved in the Services.
The restriction lasts no longer than 12 months after the person's involvement ends.
General advertisements are excluded from the restriction.
Unsolicited approaches are excluded from the restriction.
The restriction does not prohibit hiring.

proposal.summary: Narrow § 19 from a mutual no-hire covering all employees to a 12-month mutual non-solicit limited to personnel directly involved in the services, with general-advertising and unsolicited-approach carve-outs.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We cannot accept a no-hire covering every employee of the other party, so we have narrowed § 19 to our fallback: a mutual non-solicitation limited to personnel directly involved in the services, running 12 months from the end of that involvement, with carve-outs for general advertisements and unsolicited approaches and no restriction on hiring.

ops.newText: During the term of this Agreement and for a period of twelve (12) months after the end of a person's involvement in the provision of services under this Agreement, neither party shall solicit for employment any employee of the other party who was directly involved in the provision of services under this Agreement; provided that this Section does not prohibit hiring and does not apply to general advertisements or unsolicited approaches by such persons.
